title: Odometer fraud - consumer protections
facts: Rolling back, disconnecting or altering an odometer with intent to change the mileage indicated is prohibited by federal law.
Consumers can compare title mileage, maintenance records, inspection history and vehicle-history information when investigating possible mileage discrepancies.
Suspected odometer fraud can be reported through appropriate state enforcement channels and federal NHTSA resources.
A digital odometer does not eliminate the possibility of odometer fraud.
